responsibility: Declares the LoongArch D front-end integration hooks and binds them to the generic D target-hook macros. It exposes the target-version and target-info registration functions implemented in loongarch-d.cc, and defines TARGET_D_CPU_VERSIONS and TARGET_D_REGISTER_CPU_TARGET_INFO so the D front end can query LoongArch-specific builtin versions and target traits.
same_name_distinction: Unlike loongarch-d.cc, this header only declares the D target-hook entry points and binds them to TARGET_D_* macros for the front end; it does not implement the LoongArch-specific version registration or target-info logic.
